units.name: FarCall
units.summary: FarCall: call the routine at FarCallVector inside another PRG bank.

units.name: FarCallReturn
units.summary: FarCallReturn: FarCall pushes a return address here, so the far routine's RTS lands on this code;

units.name: SetPrgBank
units.summary: SetPrgBank: A bits 4-5 select the 32 KiB PRG bank (written as A>>3 to the MMC1 PRG register, whose bit 0 is ignored in 32 KiB mode).

units.name: SetChrBank
units.summary: SetChrBank: A bits 0-1 and bit 6 select a CHR bank (8 KiB index = value ((A&$40)>>4 | A&3) written x2 to MMC1 CHR0).

units.name: NextRandom
units.summary: NextRandom: RandomSeed = RandomSeed*5 + $11 (8-bit linear congruential step).

units.name: SetBanksFromValue
units.summary: SetBanksFromValue: Y/A = combined selection value.

phase1.evidence: Reached by bank-aware recursive 6502 traversal (scratch/static.py) from observed code and the reset/NMI vectors inside one 32 KiB MMC1 PRG bank (reset stub selects 32K mode, control=$02); calls to PRG-switch helpers ($81AF/$8242/$817D family), indirect jumps and BRK stop propagation; branches made unconditional by preceding immediate loads/SEC/CLC are not followed on the dead side; inline word tables after JSR $DB7E dispatcher are bounded by their lowest entry target; LDA T,X/STA zp/JMP (zp) word tables are bounded by index mask, lowest target and known code. Roots also include observed CPU addresses replicated into byte-identical copies (shared 16 KiB engine of 32K banks 4-7) and opcode-aligned copies of the common $8000-$8353 module in every bank; edges leaving those module copies are not followed unless observed (banks 4-7 copies contain unresolved JSR $FFFF placeholders, i.e. dead copies). Not executed in recorded scenarios.

units.summary: UpdateThrowInFlight (main loop): while a throw is in flight (PlayFlags bit 4) re-aim the ball from its current point toward the receiver.

units.name: ComputeFlightTime
units.summary: ComputeFlightTime: distance = sqrt(dx^2+dy^2) from the deltas in Tmp17-1A, then time = distance / ThrowSpeed (Tmp1E/1F).

units.name: VelocityY
units.summary: VelocityY, VelocityX, VelocityZ: velocity component = delta / time (Y, X and Z).

units.name: VelocityX
units.summary: VelocityX: BallVelX = distance (Tmp17/18) / flight time (Tmp1E/1F), 8.8 result.

units.name: VelocityZ
units.summary: VelocityZ: BallVelZ = MathA (set by the caller) / flight time (Tmp1E/1F).

units.name: DivU16
units.summary: DivU16: MathA:MathAHi / MathB:MathBHi -> quotient in MathA, remainder in MathR/MathRHi (restoring division, 16 iterations).

units.name: MulU8
units.summary: MulU8: MathA * MathAHi -> MathB:MathBHi (8x8 shift-and-add).

units.name: Sqrt24
units.summary: Sqrt24: integer square root of the 24-bit value Tmp10/MathA/MathAHi by summing odd numbers;

units.name: IncSaturate66
units.summary: Increment the counter at $66 up to $7F (saturating).

units.name: MoveBallFar
units.summary: FarCall bank 1 $897B: ball motion step (probably integrates position).

units.name: BuildPalette

units.name: SpriteDma

units.name: DivU16Z

units.name: MulU8Z
units.summary: MulU8Z: Ptr00+1 * Tmp02 -> Tmp03 (low) / Tmp04 (high).

units.name: LaunchVector

units.name: ScaleBySine
units.summary: ScaleBySine: BallVelX = LaunchSpeed * sin(LaunchAngle & $7F) / 256, negated when bit 7 of the angle is set;

units.name: CpuWaitCatch
units.summary: Wait until the active fielder holds the ball.

units.name: CpuStartAiScript6b

units.name: CpuRunToBaseJmp

units.name: CpuPlanAfterCatch

units.name: CpuHoldButtons

units.name: NullD8A1
units.summary: RTS stub: disabled hook or no-op handler.

units.name: CpuTimeoutMenu

units.name: CpuBatWaitRelease
units.summary: Wait for the pitch release, then arm the swing timer from the pitch speed.

units.name: CpuBatArmSwing
units.summary: CpuBatArmSwing: next state with a swing delay chosen from the pitch speed (CpuSwingDelayBySpeed).

units.name: CpuBatDelaySwing
units.summary: Wait 8 frames after release, then start the swing (A).

units.name: CpuBatPositionInBox
units.summary: Position the batter in the box toward the predicted pitch (Up/Down by height, Left/Right by lateral position) and swing late on bunts.

units.name: CpuBatBuntStance
units.summary: Square to bunt (B) for 8 frames, then follow the pitch.

units.name: CpuBatTimeout
units.summary: During a time-out: press A except on the relief scene of this side.

units.name: CpuPinchHitPick
units.summary: CpuPinchHitPick: choose a pinch hitter from E612 lists by position/handedness.

units.name: CpuPickBench
units.summary: Pick the first bench player of the requested position class (CpuPositionFilter).

units.name: CpuPickChosen
units.summary: CpuPickChosen: remember the chosen bench player, next state, return two levels up.

units.name: CpuPickBenchAlt
units.summary: Same pick without the position filter.

units.name: CpuPinchCursor
units.summary: Move the pinch-hit cursor to the chosen entry (Down presses), then confirm.

units.name: CpuPinchDone
units.summary: CpuPinchDone: cursor already on the wanted player;

units.name: CpuPinchConfirm
units.summary: CpuPinchConfirm: next state, flag the batter change and start the confirm delay.

units.name: CpuPinchExit
units.summary: Confirm (A) or cancel (B) the pinch-hit choice and leave the menu.

editorial_audit.notes: Final editorial audit (targeted, reusing valid round-3 review credit; no whole-source reread). Findings and fixes: (1) Misleading condition-derived branch labels: the generator named branches after the last symbol and the branch opcode only, so 'cmp #$04 / bne' became '@ifNmiModeNonZero' and 'lda A / cmp B / bcc' became '@ifBBelow'. tools/build.py now derives the condition from the flag-setting instruction (Is/Not/Below/AtLeast + immediate, Equal/NotEqual/Below/AtLeast + compared symbol, BitN Set/Clear after AND #single-bit, Bit0/Bit7 after shifts, Carry after ADC); 545 auto labels renamed, '_N' suffix for hex-valued collisions. Hand-chosen labels unchanged; game-meaning names kept where established. (2) Internal-process references removed from source comments: redirect r2-a1/r1-a1, round N, lead L-0xx citations in notes and in generated region notes (phase-1 evidence prefixes stripped at render time); plain evidence wording used ('runtime tests with patched RAM'). (3) Unsupported certainty: banks 3-7 module copies were called 'dead'/'never entered' and bank 0 called them 'relocated', but traces show their bank-switch helpers executing in banks 1-6; reworded to 'no known entry' for the reset/main-loop part only, label DeadModuleReset -> ModuleCopyReset. PhantomEntryAA09, AnimationStepTimes entries 2-4, DrawStepFigure and Port7000 wording changed from 'never runs/never read/may be unused/no visible effect' to no-known-reader/unresolved statements. (4) Lower-confidence classifications made explicit at each region: L-024 code (2,426 B, 0.75) and NullHook9CAC (0.6) carry 'classified by structure/layout only; whether the game runs it is unresolved'; all 78 pattern-based generic data regions (0.75) carry 'data by byte patterns only; format and consumer unknown except where labelled'; truncated evidence clauses ending in ';' now end cleanly. (5) ram.inc: ModeFlags bits 4-6 documented (bit 5 resets the CPU opponent state), Port7000 writers/readers stated; stale score-swap history removed. (6) L-005 inline dispatch extents verified statically and documented at CpuFieldTable/CpuBatTable/DemoTable. Consistency checks: no raw RAM operands where a ram.inc symbol exists, no automatic Sub_/Lxxxx labels (Data_9490 deliberately kept and explained), no global code label without a comment, only the known 4 unlabeled post-RTS continuations; button bits (A=$80, Start=$10), HomeScore/VisitorScore, PennantCounterA (game number) and ScaleLaunchByHomeLead texts consistent with corrected findings. Sample review of every bank found no further concrete defects. Remaining open items are semantic only (commentary/uncertainties.md). Review entries: 1497/1497 reviewed, 1889 units; 645 entries re-reviewed because their rendered text changed, 852 carried by identical range and text. Pre-audit state preserved in analysis/round-3/commentary/.
